rules: Every artifact must have one strict v1 input and PASS output accepted by the primary and independent base-contract verifiers.
The immutable replay library digest is both state-before and state-after for every artifact and retention is true.
Exactly one complete A4 mount process-tree receipt is canonicalized and hash-identified.
All 23 artifact bindings name that receipt and repeat only its exact base-contract resource projection.
Aggregate accounting charges the unique resource receipt once, never 23 times.
All three frozen replay tools remain visible in every artifact output as reused or none according to direct-use count.
Unknown fields, changed digests, duplicate artifacts, changed resource projections, changed state, inflated multipliers, or prospective claims fail closed.
